handbook.craftmorkovsk.welcome.title: Welcome, Farmer
handbook.craftmorkovsk.welcome.1: Welcome to the Morkovsk valley, where carrot farming is treated with an unreasonable amount of seriousness.
handbook.craftmorkovsk.welcome.2: Till Morkovsk soil, plant seeds, keep the dirt hydrated and harvest produce. Better soil and water mean better quality.
handbook.craftmorkovsk.welcome.3: Sell produce for morkoins, earn farming XP, climb the ranks, and maybe one day you will meet THE CARROT.
handbook.craftmorkovsk.crops.title: Crop Catalogue
handbook.craftmorkovsk.soils.title: Soils & Fertilizer
handbook.craftmorkovsk.soils.intro: Crops grow on soil tiers. Higher tiers grow faster and roll better quality:
handbook.craftmorkovsk.soils.fertilizer: Use a compost bin and fertilizers to upgrade soil. Harvesting can degrade soil, so feed it again.
handbook.craftmorkovsk.machines.title: Machines
handbook.craftmorkovsk.machines.intro: Processing machines turn raw produce into goods and seeds. They run on Forge Energy:
handbook.craftmorkovsk.machines.note: Right-click a machine to open its interface and feed it items.
handbook.craftmorkovsk.energy.title: Energy Primer
handbook.craftmorkovsk.energy.1: Machines need FE. Generators burn fuel, biomass generators burn plant matter, and cables carry power to machines and batteries.
handbook.craftmorkovsk.energy.2: Small generator: %s FE/t. Biomass generator: %s FE/t.
handbook.craftmorkovsk.energy.3: A running machine pulls about %s FE/t. Keep a battery charged so production never stops.
handbook.craftmorkovsk.animals.title: Farm Animals
handbook.craftmorkovsk.animals.intro: The valley's livestock keeps your pantry and your fields supplied:
handbook.craftmorkovsk.animals.note: Keep a feeding trough stocked and animals will breed and produce on their own.
handbook.craftmorkovsk.economy.title: Economy
handbook.craftmorkovsk.economy.intro: Produce sells for morkoins; the base crop price is %s mk and prices drift ±%s%% daily. Quality multiplies the price:
handbook.craftmorkovsk.economy.note: Rich soil, hydration and farming level all push quality upward.
handbook.craftmorkovsk.levels.title: Farming Ranks
handbook.craftmorkovsk.levels.intro: Earn XP by planting, harvesting, breeding and processing. Ranks:
handbook.craftmorkovsk.carrot.title: A Legend
handbook.craftmorkovsk.carrot.1: Old farmers whisper of THE CARROT — a crop so slow that seasons pass before a single leaf unfolds.
handbook.craftmorkovsk.carrot.2: They say it only accepts fertilized soil, and that whoever harvests it will be remembered by the earth itself.
